note: Canonical H2 headings per spec file, one Korean set. spec.validate requires every heading listed under headings to be present in the corresponding file. Order is not enforced; presence is. A heading that is not listed here is allowed. Files listed in absent_ok are optional stages: their absence produces no finding at all. 02-screens.md is deliberately NOT in absent_ok: its absence is a plain missing_optional warn by default, escalated to a fail against 04-tasks.md by spec.py's _check_screens_required (ADR-0017) whenever 01-prd.md is UI-bearing (no [non-ui] marker) — a conditional rule that a static list cannot express.
